notes: WorldId strings match Canon.cs: Hub, Ruins, Tunya, Fantasy, Crime, Cyber, Frontier, Superhero, Crucible, Sere.
Fantasy is the Sundering. Hub is the Unburned Court. Flower Law radius is 42m and the Arena exception stands.
Pinewood Crossing is the salt-road name. Humanoids stay CX. No Quaternius bodies.
Rows with canon_source keep that file authoritative for voice_lines and breadcrumbs. This file adds faction_delta, world_hooks, and a bind loop.
SkillLattice is still a lookup. skill_ids are references to skills/SKILLS.json, not live talents.
Sere has no Canon quests folder. Those eight loops are new.
Coin may be negative when the loop is a purchase. That is a cost, not a reward mint.
